en: Revelation 9

p.src: 1  The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

ja: くと、空から地上に落ちた
en: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.
u.src: 1  The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

p.src: 2  He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

ja: くと、その穴から、燃える
en: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.
u.src: 2  He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

ja: 9:2 TRは「大きな」を加えている。
en: 9:2 TR adds “great”

p.src: 3  Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

en: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
u.src: 3  Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

p.src: 4  They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

ja: も、どんな緑のものも、どの
en: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.
u.src: 4  They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

p.src: 5  They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

ja: しめる力が与えられた。その
en: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.
u.src: 5  They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

p.src: 6  In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

en: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.
u.src: 6  In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

p.src: 7  The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

en: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.
u.src: 7  The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

p.src: 8  They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

en: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.
u.src: 8  They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

p.src: 9  They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.

en: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.
u.src: 9  They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.

p.src: 10  They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

en: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.
u.src: 10  They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

p.src: 11  They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.

ja: いが王として君臨している。その
では「アポリュオン」という。
en: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.
u.src: 11  They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.

ja:
9:11 「アバドン」はヘブル語で、「荒廃」「破壊」または「破壊の場所」という意味である。
9:11 「アポリュオン」は「破壊する者」という意味である。
en:
9:11 “Abaddon” is a Hebrew word that means “ruin”, “destruction”, or “the place of destruction”
9:11 “Apollyon” means “Destroyer”.

p.src: 12  The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

en: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.
u.src: 12  The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

p.src: 13  The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

en: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,
u.src: 13  The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

p.src: 14  saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

ja: ユーフラテスのほとりにつながれている
en: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”
u.src: 14  saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

p.src: 15  The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

ja: すると、人類の三分の一を殺すため、その
えられていた四人の御使いが解き放たれた。
en: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.
u.src: 15  The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

p.src: 16  The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

en: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.
u.src: 16  The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

ja: 9:16 直訳すると「万の幾万倍」
en: 9:16 literally, “ten thousands of ten thousands”

p.src: 17  Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

ja: たちは、炎の赤、ヒヤシンスの
en: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.
u.src: 17  Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

p.src: 18  By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

en: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.
u.src: 18  By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

p.src: 19  For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.

en: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.
u.src: 19  For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.

p.src: 20  The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.

ja: するのをやめなかった。
en: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.
u.src: 20  The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.

p.src: 21  They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.

en: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.
u.src: 21  They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.

ja: 9:21 「魔術」と訳された言葉（ファルマケイア）には、調合薬、毒薬、薬物の使用という意味も含まれる。
en: 9:21 The word for “sorceries” (pharmakeia) also implies the use of potions, poisons, and drugs
